component.name: Anvil
component.summary: Video encoding, simple by default and tweakable underneath

description.p: Anvil encodes films and series in the spirit of StaxRip: drop a file, a folder, a Blu-ray or a DVD and press Encode. Underneath, every setting can be changed.

ul.li: x265, x264, SVT-AV1 and rav1e on the CPU; NVIDIA, Intel Quick Sync, AMD and VAAPI on the GPU
True 10-bit with HDR10, Dolby Vision 8.1 and HDR10+ kept, checked after every encode
Lossless audio first, then AC-3; subtitles, OCR to SRT and chapters
VapourSynth filters with a live preview and crop
A batch queue that survives restarts, presets with per-source rules

description.p: First stable release: GPU encoders, x264 and rav1e, encoder option pages, Flatpak and AppImage.
